charts.title: TOI-6894 b: orbits around TOI-6894
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-6894's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-6894 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Bryant et al. 2025 (2025NatAs...9.1031B), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname BRYANT_ET_AL_2025): P 3.37077196 d

charts.title: TOI-6894 b: its transit
charts.description: TOI-6894 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 1 sector (72) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 67512645, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 6-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 6-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
